title: One key idea, restated at the close
statement: Give each lesson one key idea and close on it, with the student restating it, finding evidence for it in the text and applying it as support fades.
detail: A unit knowledge base gives each lesson one key threshold the child should walk away knowing, with a second carried subtly, and has every child leave having restated that threshold with evidence. A walkthrough of a rebuilt lesson reports that a conformance review found the closing statement missing everywhere, and that it now lands in every lesson. Built lessons are checked for that close.
against: The conformance finding is second-hand: the walkthrough reports another review's result.
